nodes.label: Repository pattern
nodes.rationale: Mediates between domain and data mapping with a collection-like interface; extra layer buys testability and swap-ability.

nodes.label: Strategy pattern
nodes.rationale: Interchangeable algorithms behind a common interface selected at runtime; trades flexibility against type proliferation.

nodes.label: Single Responsibility Principle (SRP)
nodes.rationale: A module should have one reason to change; split when concerns change for different reasons or are tested differently.

nodes.label: Open-Closed Principle (OCP)
nodes.rationale: Open for extension via new adapters/strategies, closed for modification of stable use-case flow; introduce extension points when a second real variant arrives.

nodes.label: Liskov Substitution Principle (LSP)
nodes.rationale: Substitutes must honor the same contract preconditions, postconditions, and error meaning without caller special-casing.

nodes.label: Interface Segregation Principle (ISP)
nodes.rationale: Prefer small focused interfaces so clients depend only on methods they use; segregate when a second client would depend on unused methods.

nodes.label: Dependency Inversion Principle (DIP)
nodes.rationale: High-level policy depends on abstractions (ports), not low-level SDKs; DI supplies abstractions but DIP defines dependency direction.

nodes.label: Hono backend architecture
nodes.rationale: Thin HTTP edge over application use cases; Hono handles routing while business rules live in application and domain packages.

nodes.label: Database abstraction (port + adapters)
nodes.rationale: One repository port per feature with libSQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL adapters; dialect differences documented and contract-tested.

nodes.label: Mobile architecture (Capacitor + React)
nodes.rationale: Native shell around React via Capacitor; shared domain with web and small adapters for plugins and secure storage.

nodes.label: Monorepo structure
nodes.rationale: pnpm workspace where apps are deployable edges and packages hold shared rules; composition roots live only in apps.

nodes.label: ADR 0001 — Monorepo tooling
nodes.rationale: pnpm workspaces plus Turborepo, TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, and Playwright for low-ceremony CI pipelines.

nodes.label: ADR 0002 — Database access approach
nodes.rationale: Ports in application, one adapter per vendor in db, hand-written SQL first, contract tests, libSQL then Postgres then MariaDB.

nodes.label: ADR 0003 — Package scope and boundaries
nodes.rationale: @fsab scope with domain free of framework imports; packages must not import apps; packages/ui is client-safe React only.

nodes.label: Tech space documentation

nodes.label: packages/db

nodes.label: Full-Stack Architecture Blueprint
nodes.rationale: Open-source, interview-ready learning monorepo teaching architecture through working examples; documentation-first until blueprint approval.

nodes.label: Database abstraction design
nodes.rationale: Support libSQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL without pretending they are identical; shared port, per-adapter dialect SQL, capability flags, per-vendor migrations, integration tests per adapter.

nodes.label: Hono backend request flow
nodes.rationale: HTTP through middleware, Zod validation at routes, use cases in application package, ports, DB adapters, response/error mappers; manual composition root createApp(deps) without IoC container unless complexity forces it.

nodes.label: API observability
nodes.rationale: requestId on every log line and error response; structured logs; health endpoint; avoid PII in logs by default.

nodes.label: Security baseline
nodes.rationale: Validate at API edge; parameterized SQL only; secrets in env; security headers and tight CORS; HttpOnly cookies or documented token strategy for auth later.
